messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot scoping: hosting options & cost scenarios

Thanks again for the time today — quick written recap and concrete next steps so we can size the pilot and price appropriately. High-level notes from the discovery: 

- Primary workload: real-time customer support summarization + short-form generation (~30–80 tokens per call).
- Expected pilot volume: ~250k requests/day peak, average concurrency ~150, spikes to ~400 for 10–15 minutes/day.
- Latency SLO: p95 < 350ms for inference path.
- Data controls: PII redaction required; logs stored for 30 days; US-only data residency.
- Timeline: pilot kickoff target 6/21, 4-week pilot.

Three deployment options to consider (attached spreadsheet includes a worked example):

1) Hosted API (fastest path)
   - Pros: no infra setup, predictable per-token pricing, immediate ramp.
   - Cons: higher unit cost at scale, less control of dedicated throughput.

2) Dedicated (reserved capacity)
   - Pros: predictable throughput, lower per-token cost at commit levels, autoscale/burst available.
   - Cons: commit required, startup lead (provisioning GPUs).

3) Private (VPC / on-prem)
   - Pros: full network/control, helps compliance/regulatory constraints.
   - Cons: engineering integration, one-time setup, longer lead time.

Attached: orbit-pilot-scenarios.xlsx (3 scenarios) and redwood-pricing-matrix.pdf (assumptions).

Requests / next steps: 
- Samir/Dana: confirm which scenario you want us to model in detail (Hosted pilot vs Dedicated 3-GPU reserve vs Private VPC baseline).
- If Dedicated or Private: confirm acceptable commit window (monthly / quarterly / annual) and any procurement constraints.
- Proposed working session: 30 minutes to walk the math (we can run numbers live) — are you available Thurs 6/10 10–11am PT or Fri 6/11 9–11am PT?

Thanks — will prepare an abbreviated SOW & costing doc once you indicate which path to model.

—

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A few clarifying questions before we pick a scenario to model in depth: 

On Hosted API: 
- Is the per-token estimate in the sheet including streaming overhead and typical tokenizer split for our prompt/response shapes?
- Do you support a burst cap so we don't hit throttling during the 400-concurrency spikes?

On Dedicated:

On Private VPC:

Also, from procurement side: what does an initial pilot PO look like (term, cancellation, SLAs)? Dana is on copy for procurement/contracting.

Great questions — short answers plus a conservative ballpark so you can compare paths. These are rough; we'll refine once you pick a scenario to model. Assumptions: 250k req/day, avg 60 tokens output, 1.2x input+prompt tokens, caching of common prefixes reduces token count by ~12% for summaries.

Hosted API (pilot, 4 weeks)
- Estimate: ~$12k–$18k total (per-token billing) depending on prompt length and exact request shape. No setup fee, immediate start.
- Throttling: we can set burst allowances (short spikes) — rate limit behavior configurable per-key.

Dedicated (3x A100-style GPUs reserve, monthly commit)
- Provisioning lead: ~5–7 business days after PO.
- Monthly committed cost (example): $28k/month commit for 3 GPU capacity, effective unit cost ~40–55% lower than Hosted at high utilization. Burst: can route to hosted capacity for surges (configurable fallback).

Private VPC (customer-managed network)
- One-time engineering/onboarding: estimate 80–120 engineer hours (~$18k–$28k professional services) plus baseline infra costs; ongoing capacity priced similar to Dedicated but with additional infra pass-through if on-prem.
- Lead time: 3–6 weeks depending on networking approvals.

Attachments include: short worked examples in the spreadsheet and a compact pricing matrix (pdf) with the assumptions above.

If you want, Ben and Jonas from our infra/product teams are happy to join a 30-minute math session to step through the workbook live.

Next steps: please reply with the deployment variant you'd like us to fully model and preferred slot for a 30-minute work session. Once we agree, I'll circulate an abbreviated SOW + pilot PO template.
